gloss: to read too much; to overinterpret; to overthink

definitions.explanation: To spend too much time reading, or to read an excessive amount of material.

definitions.gloss: to overinterpret; to read too much into something; to overthink
definitions.explanation: To find meanings or intentions that are not actually there, attributing excessive significance to words, actions, or situations.

examples.japanese: ⟦{漫画|まんが}→漫画：01511_manga⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{読|よ}み{過|す}ぎて⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{疲|つか}れた→疲れる：00901_tsukareru⟧。
examples.english: I read too many manga and my eyes got tired.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夜|よる}→夜：00487_yoru⟧⟦{遅|おそ}く→遅い：00533_osoi⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{小説|しょうせつ}→小説：01434_shousetsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{読|よ}み{過|す}ぎてしまった。
examples.english: I ended up reading novels too late into the night.

examples.japanese: ⟦スマホ→スマホ：04721_sumaho⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{画面|がめん}→画面：04406_gamen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{読|よ}み{過|す}ぎる⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{肩|かた}→肩：02192_kata⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧こる。
examples.english: Reading your phone screen too much causes stiff shoulders.

examples.japanese: ⟦{相手|あいて}→相手：01677_aite⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{言葉|ことば}→言葉：02880_kotoba⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{読|よ}み{過|す}ぎない⟦ほうがいい→ほうがいい：10078_hougaii⟧。
examples.english: It's better not to read too much into what the other person says.

examples.japanese: ⟦{空気|くうき}→空気：01390_kuuki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{読|よ}み{過|す}ぎて⟦{疲|つか}れる→疲れる：00901_tsukareru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Sometimes I get tired from overthinking the social atmosphere.

examples.japanese: ⟦メール→メール：04435_meeru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{文面|ぶんめん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{読|よ}み{過|す}ぎて、⟦{返信|へんしん}→返信：14350_henshin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦かかった→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧。
examples.english: I overanalyzed the wording of the email and it took me a long time to reply.

notes:
A compound verb from ⟦{読|よ}む→読む：00426_yomu⟧ (to read) + ⟦{過|す}ぎる→過ぎる：01219_sugiru⟧ (to exceed; too much). Sense 2 is particularly common in modern Japanese, where ⟦{読|よ}む→読む：00426_yomu⟧ extends beyond literal reading to mean interpreting social cues, situations, and hidden meanings.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{空気|くうき}→空気：01390_kuuki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{読|よ}み{過|す}ぎる: to overread the room; to be too sensitive to social atmosphere
- ⟦{相手|あいて}→相手：01677_aite⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{気持|きも}ち⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{読|よ}み{過|す}ぎる: to overanalyze someone's feelings
- ⟦{行間|ぎょうかん}→行間：07324_gyoukan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{読|よ}み{過|す}ぎる: to read too much between the lines

USAGE:
The figurative sense (overinterpreting) has become especially relevant in discussions about social anxiety and the pressure of ⟦{空気|くうき}を{読|よ}む→空気を読む：06306_kuukiwoyomu⟧ culture in Japan.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{考|かんが}え→考える：00856_kangaeru⟧⟦{過|す}ぎる→過ぎる：01219_sugiru⟧: to overthink — more general, not limited to interpreting
- ⟦{深読|ふかよ}みする→深読みする：22993_fukayomisuru⟧: to read deeply into something — similar but neutral, can be positive
